findings.highlight: Who the hell is it
findings.evidenceJa: ドコのドイツだ馬鹿野郎
findings.governingReading: where is this “who”—this German—coming from, damn it
findings.explanation: The rapid どこ／どいつ／ドイツ wordplay in Shirou’s argument with his own heartbeat disappears.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka Rin in plain clothes
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂凛の私服
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka Rin in casual clothes
findings.explanation: 私服 means clothing outside uniform or official dress; “plain clothes” misleadingly suggests visually plain clothing immediately after the flashy red-and-black description.

findings.highlight: I just saw her in something other than the school uniform
findings.evidenceJa: 不意打ちに、制服姿じゃない遠坂を見ただけ
findings.governingReading: I was merely caught off guard by seeing Tohsaka out of uniform
findings.explanation: The fact that the sight blindsides Shirou and explains his disproportionate reaction disappears.

findings.highlight: I have to answer her trust
findings.evidenceJa: その信用に応えるコトが第一
findings.governingReading: My first priority is to live up to that trust
findings.explanation: A defining statement of Shirou’s reciprocal duty is rendered in non-English idiom.

findings.highlight: After that[line4]I feel something outrageous on my chest.
findings.evidenceJa: 黙って……！
findings.governingReading: Be quiet…!
findings.explanation: The mature-text branch inserts explicit chest-contact narration with no active Japanese textual counterpart.

findings.highlight: He’ll hear us if we’re loud
findings.evidenceJa: 騒ぐと見つかっちゃう
findings.governingReading: We’ll be discovered if you make noise
findings.explanation: The consequence is discovery; the English prematurely specifies auditory detection and a male observer.

findings.highlight: pushes her body onto mine
findings.evidenceJa: 体を寄せてくる
findings.governingReading: presses her body close to mine
findings.explanation: Rin crowding closer into the hiding place is sexualized into pushing her body onto Shirou’s.

findings.highlight: It feels like a firm piece of meat is being pushed onto the cutting board to make it flat.
findings.evidenceJa: 体を寄せてくる遠坂
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka presses herself closer
findings.explanation: The mature-text branch invents a grotesque meat-and-cutting-board simile absent from the active Japanese.

findings.highlight: “B-Breasts, Tohsaka, breasts………!!!” I think I’m saying a very dangerous thing, but I can’t comprehend myself. The sensation is so great that my brain has turned into a sponge.
findings.governingReading: “T-Tohsaka, i-it’s too narr—!” He is too overheated by their closeness to understand his own babbling.
findings.explanation: The mature-text branch replaces Shirou’s broken active line and narration with explicit breasts, danger, sensation, and sponge imagery.

findings.highlight: The strange guy that’s standing
findings.evidenceJa: なんか、ヘンなヤツが立ってない？
findings.governingReading: Doesn’t it look like some strange guy is standing there?
findings.explanation: Rin’s tentative invitation to inspect the figure becomes a settled description.

findings.highlight: a legitimate human with form
findings.evidenceJa: 肉を持った[ruby text=れっき]歴とした人間
findings.governingReading: a bona fide human being of flesh and blood
findings.explanation: The contrast between embodied humanity and Servants loses its concrete flesh-and-blood basis.

findings.highlight: He is so ominous that I can declare so
findings.evidenceJa: そう断言できるほど、今の男は不吉だった
findings.governingReading: The man was ominous enough for me to state that with certainty
findings.explanation: The English is malformed at the moment Shirou calibrates the stranger as lethally dangerous.

findings.highlight: as fast as Lancer
findings.evidenceJa: ランサーもかくや、という身のこなし
findings.governingReading: with movement that might have rivaled Lancer
findings.explanation: A broad comic comparison to Lancer’s physical movement is narrowed to measured speed.

findings.highlight: it’s not fair if she’s the only one who can make a face like that
findings.evidenceJa: 自分だけそーゆー顔をするのは、よくない
findings.governingReading: it is not fair for her alone to wear that kind of expression
findings.explanation: Shirou objects to Rin acting as though only she was imposed upon; the English turns this into an odd claim about her exclusive ability to make a face.

findings.highlight: By the way, Tohsaka. Issei has nothing to do with all this.
findings.evidenceJa: とりあえず一成は関係ない
findings.governingReading: For now, Tohsaka, Issei is in the clear.
findings.explanation: A transition that advances their investigation becomes an incidental aside.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka speaks plainly
findings.evidenceJa: あっさりと、遠坂はそんな返答をしやがった
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka gave that answer without a moment’s hesitation
findings.explanation: Rin’s immediate trust, which dissolves Shirou’s sulk, is reduced to manner of speech.

findings.highlight: no matter how much magical energy or Master’s presence he hides
findings.evidenceJa: どんなに気配を殺そうが魔力を抑えようが
findings.governingReading: no matter how completely he suppresses his presence or magical energy
findings.explanation: The English makes magical energy and “Master’s presence” grammatical agents that hide things.

findings.highlight: I took off his shirt by force
findings.evidenceJa: 力ずくで上着をはぎ取った
findings.governingReading: I tore off his outer jacket by force
findings.explanation: The garment Shirou says he forcibly removed changes from Issei’s outer uniform to his shirt.

findings.highlight: I found that out when I went to visit the archery club
findings.evidenceJa: 弓道部に通ってれば判る
findings.governingReading: Anyone who regularly goes by the archery club would know
findings.explanation: Rin’s evasive appeal to routine visibility becomes a claim about one completed visit.

findings.highlight: I’m friends with the captain, Mitsuzuri-san
findings.evidenceJa: 主将の美綴さんと知り合い
findings.governingReading: I know the captain, Mitsuzuri-san
findings.explanation: Rin’s limited claim of acquaintance is strengthened into friendship.

findings.highlight: Children who are raised by a stranger after they are born, and how they might feel
findings.evidenceJa: その後でもう一度、選択の余地もなく知らない他人に育てられる子供の気持ち
findings.governingReading: how a child feels when, after being unable to choose their parents, they are once again given no choice and raised by unknown strangers
findings.explanation: The English changes “once again” into “after birth,” losing Shirou’s recognition of adoption as a second involuntary assignment of parents.

findings.highlight: I don’t think it’s a big problem
findings.evidenceJa: どういう気持ちもないだろ
findings.governingReading: There probably is no single special way they would feel
findings.explanation: Shirou refuses to universalize the adopted child’s feelings; the English instead minimizes adoption as not a large problem.

findings.highlight: before it gets dark
findings.evidenceJa: 沈みかけた夕日が消える前に
findings.governingReading: before the setting sun disappears
findings.explanation: The concrete sunset deadline and closing image are generalized to darkness.
